name: A quiet working signal
meaning: Three small marks move while the agent is working. Activity, not percentage complete.
cost: 3 small layers · 3.6 s per preview · transform + opacity · no terminal animation
risk: Continuous motion across twelve panes becomes noise. In production, animate only the focused working pane.
label: Working signal

name: An invitation, not an alarm
meaning: The needs-you chip arrives once. The persistent amber label carries the state after motion stops.
cost: 1 small layer · 520 ms · transform + opacity · one event, no pulse loop
risk: A waiting inference is not a confirmed request. Keep the same status semantics Nest already uses.
label: Agent needs you

name: New output settles in
meaning: A short arrival marks new unread output. The green chip stays until the pane is read; it does not certify success.
cost: 1 small layer · 420 ms · transform + opacity · one event per unread transition
risk: Do not replay on every output chunk. Trigger only when the pane first becomes unread.
label: New unread output

name: A receipt arrives
meaning: A small receipt appears in the pane footer when a full memory record is returned to this session. Retrieved, not proven applied.
cost: 1 small layer · 640 ms · transform + opacity · reserved footer, no moving terminal
risk: Requires a read event attributed to this pane and record revision. No animation from guessed memory usage.
label: Memory retrieved

name: A place for the next agent
meaning: A reserved slot receives the new pane identity. Only its 32px header enters; the terminal stays still.
cost: 1 header layer · 320 ms · transform + opacity · one DOM insertion, no animated grid geometry
risk: This prototype reserves the slot. A production layout change still has one layout cost; never interpolate terminal dimensions.
label: Pane joined the workspace
